_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 74 recent 12h windows showing ±2+ point moves, this is a confirmed low-volatility coil where HOLD is the only statistically honest call — the August 2024 analog suggests eventual upward resolution, but the coil has not broken yet.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst forward-calls Disbelief (up 4 rungs, rule-violating) while the narrative implies imminent absorption; consensus holds at Panic pending breakout evidence
